notes.title: TALES OF DESTRUCTION update is now OUT!
notes.content:
The [b]TALES OF DESTRUCTION[/b] update is now out!

This update brings plenty of new content, so let me highlight the major features :)

A [b]high score and rank system[/b] have been implemented on each map as well as an overall Story, rank and high score. Learn and earn the score multipliers to go from NOVICE to the rank LORD OF TOOLS.

[b]TALES[/b]: A new game mode has come with its first [b]level, Distribution Hub[/b]. Experience RETOOLED turn up to 11. :)

[b]Weapon alt fire[/b]: Each weapon has received an alternative fire option. Expanding the way you wreck your enemies. With weapon alt fires, new weapon combos have appeared as well as a [b]new crosshair system[/b] that will more efficiently display weapon information.

It has been a lot work getting this update ready for release, and I hope you all like it! The full patch notes are below.

As a final note, I just wanted to say thank you all taking a chance on RETOOLED and looking forward I am really excited about what is coming up next for RETOOLED. Update Master Of Destruction is now estimated for late Q3 or early Q4 2024. 

Have a great week everyone!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch Notes Tales Of Destruction

NEW
 - TALES (New game mode), level DISTRIBUTION HUB: SKY's call for destruction will not go unanswered.
 - High score and Rank system. Wreck your enemies in style to achieve your best score and climb the ranks. Implemented on all maps as well as an overall story, rank and high score.
 - Alt fire for each weapon. Designed complement your arsenal and giving you more options to dispose of your foes.
 -- See the help menu for more info on each weapon alt fire and tips for weapon combinations.
 - The golden tool, each story map now contains a hidden "golden tool". Picking it up gives a temporary highscore multiplier.
 - Multiple levels have gotten minor changes, mainly layout and lightning updates.
 - The help menu now has new entries detailing how the high score system functions, score events and multipliers.
 - 7 new achievements.

HUD UPDATE
 - New crosshair system that allows for greater information display within each weapon's crosshair as well as new animations. 
 - High score display widget added, togglable and scalable. Off by default.
 -- Weapon state display close to crosshair, togglable with an opacity setting.

CHANGES
 - Weapon switching and firing code has been overhauled. This fixed a logic bug that could delay the first shot fired after switching weapons in some cases. The overall weapon switching is now faster.
 - AI Utility and Omni bots have received shield changes. Instead of reducing incoming damage they now have a separate shield pool.
 - Multiple enemies have now been marked as "High Value Targets" throughout the levels. Destroy them to get a temporary highscore multiplier. (High score display widget needs to be enabled)
 - Player robot has received a texture update.
 - Distribution hub's level challenges count towards progression unlocks.
 - Change default keybindings for zoom, melee and added a new one for weapon alt fire.

OPTIMIZATIONS
 - Several VFX impacts have been optimized.

BUG FIXES
 - Awakening Boosted jump tutorial will now close if you skip skill check area.

notes.title: RETOOLED : Dev Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I wanted to give you all an update on the development of RETOOLED and what to expect for the future.

First of all, today I'm releasing [b]update 1.0.8[/b] which contains: New melee attack, camera shake overhaul, new enemy death animations, QOL features, HUD updates, more help menu entries and a few bug fixes and balancing.

Work is progressing on the big [b]1.1 update[/b], now called [b]Tales Of Destruction[/b]. I'm aiming to release Tales Of Destruction early Q1 2024 and for FREE. :) I will take more about what to expect from this update early next year.

I can also announce Tales of Destruction won't be the only addition next year, the prep work has already begun on [b]1.2[/b], [b]Masters of destruction[/b] which I hope to release the first half of 2024 and for free :D

I hope to see you all in 2024 and remember, keep wrecking those bots! 
/ Oliver - Swarm Creations

Patch notes for 1.0.8:

[list]
[*] NEW - Melee attack, you can finally punch those pesky bots. Dash + melee, charges the attack dealing even more damage and pushes enemies further away!
[*] NEW - Physics death animations for all enemy bots, punch or explode them to destruction to trigger these new animations!
[*] NEW - Camera shake system overhaul, nothing was left untouched. Actions and movement now feel more impact full. Not a fan of camera shakes? There is an option to put them to low or turn off player induced camera shakes.
- Several AI attacks can now cause smaller camera shakes.
[*] NEW - Help menu now contains the enemy roster, read up on the foes you face.
[*] HUD updates:
- Hit indicator size and animation updated. Its opacity setting is now exposed to the user.
- Critical damage post process effect added, color now fades out when approaching critical damage. Changed message's position and size.

My goal is to increase the information intake in the heat of the moment. Feel free to drop suggestions for future additions.
[*] Bug fixes:
- Wasp tank direct rocket hits should now deal damage.
- Parabellum arena skip fixed.
- Weapons and abilities missed gets still unlocked at the end of the level.
[*] Smaller optimizations to some of the projectiles.
[/list]

Want a peak behind the curtain? Well then.. development of RETOOLEDs future content happens over on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCjbXVu2w-ijehyvWwGkUafQ]Youtube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/swarmcreations]Twitch[/url]. Feel free to follow along! :)

notes.title: New Tools Of Destruction update is now OUT!
notes.content:
The [b]New Tools Of Destruction[/b] update is out now!

This update massively expands the arsenal in RETOOLED with [b]9 new abilities[/b] and [b]4 new pieces of equipment[/b]. :) Your preference of destruction gets expanded by completing level challenges.

But that is not all!

[list]
[*] Movement : These adjustments are made to make you feel more in control of your movement.
[list]
[*] Base top speed increase from 1200 - 1300
[*] Acceleration increase from 11250 - 15750
[*] Uniformed the air control amount, no longer varies dependent on z velocity. Slightly increased air control in relation to top speed.
[*] Perch radius lowered from 70 - 40. This allows you to stand closer to ledges without falling off.
[*] Travel mode now also affects your acceleration and deaceleration making you more agile than before.
[/list]
[*] Lv. Parabellum has gotten a reinforcement update. 
[list]
[*] 2 arenas have been reworked
[*] Overall art polish
[*] Lightning update
[*] Boosted jump mark indicators have been added to help new players identify arena pathway options. [/list]
[*] Speedrunning stats display for each level and overall story completion time for each difficulty.

[*] 3 new achievements tied to overall story completion time.

[*] Menu updates
[list]
[*] Visual overhaul, backgrounds/colors.
[*] Help menu got several new entries for new abilities and equipment along with a structural overhaul.
[*] New loadout menu, accessible in story menu as well as between levels so you can make changes without going back to main menu.
[*] New tooltip, visual overhaul and more expansive information display.
[*] Weapons tutorial in Awakening got a small highlight update.
[*] Level outro menu adjustments, stats display addition and visual update.
[*] Objective icons in the world got several changes to their transparency calculation. They are now more visible when looked at and fades in and out more quickly.
[*] Challenge icon updates.
[/list]
[*] Sound / Music
[list]
[*] Jumping SFX pass, now differentiate between Jumping/Boosted Jump/Double jump/Bunny hopping and Jumppack.
[*] Level "Cooldown" got several music changes, it is now more varied and in line with the overall tone.
[/list]
[*] Bug fixes
[list]
[*] Disrupter bot will no longer trigger the end of the jump attack after death.
[*] ESD Grenade now requires 2 plasma bolts to be charged. Explosion VFX will now trigger correctly once charged.
[*] The level challenge display will now display level names correctly.
[*] Wasp tank laser beam attack now stops correctly at death.
[*] Wasp tank logic fixes when entering and exiting defensive mode. (Known issue, can in rare cases have it's shield active even if not in defensive mode.)
[*] Parabellum, hidden disrupter bot trigger fixes.
[/list]
[*] Multiple grammatical errors fixed. 
[/list]
Developing this update has also meant doing a bunch of prep work for the upcoming 1.1 patch that will be the next larger patch coming to RETOOLED, want to follow along the development and peek behind the curtain? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/HFC4sn6AC8]discord[/url] or catch the live streams over on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/swarmcreations]Twitch[/url].
 

For now, bunny hop your way into the action a wreck some bots with your new tools! Will you manage to complete the new achievement STORY: PhD in RETOOLED?

notes.title: Deep dive #4 - What is easy and what is hard?
notes.content:
Salutations! It is time for the fourth post in the deep dives series, today we are looking into how RETOOLED is handling difficulty levels.

To start off this deep dive I would like to explain my view on difficulty levels and their goal in RETOOLED as I believe the perception of what a certain difficulty level should be differs a lot from gamer to gamer.

It is important to me that I do not alter the core gameplay DNA when creating different difficulty levels in RETOOLED. I do not want RETOOLED to go from a momentum shooter to a cover shooter, instead the idea is to increase the pressure on the player. To achieve this: 
[list][*] I have created an [b]“attack token”[/b] request [b]system [/b]for AIs where they have to ask for permission to attack. This gives me greater control to not only make sure there aren't too uneven difficulty spikes within a map but also establish the baseline pressure for each difficulty level.
[*] I slightly [b]tweak AI behaviors[/b] like their reaction time to player focus, their need to [b]avoid [/b]being targeted, [b]defensive abilities cooldown[/b] and their [b]charges[/b].
[*] [b]Attack option selection[/b] to either slightly favor weaker or stronger attacks dependent on difficulty level.
[*] [b]Minor stat boosts[/b], some % are AI dependent so not all are equal.
[/list]
[h2]Normal[/h2] is the intended way for RETOOLED to be experienced. RETOOLED is meant to be challenging so the normal difficulty level can seem tough.

100% attack tokens
100% damage
100% health
Standard behavior/reactions
Starts levels with the intended amount of extra lives.

[h2]Easy[/h2] is for those struggling with normal, it’s more of cruise mode for the player but expect to die if you lose focus.

60% attack tokens 
80% damage 
80%(ish) health, AI dependent
Slower reaction times, slightly favors weaker attacks than baseline.
Starts levels with +1 of the intended amount of extra lives.

[h2]Hard[/h2] is for those that are looking for a challenge and It is recommened as a second playthrough. Knowledge of weapons and abilities combos as well as a few locations of extra lives throughout the levels is recommended.

140% attack tokens
120% damage
120%(ish) health, AI dependent
Quicker reaction times, slightly favors stronger attacks than baseline.
Starts levels with 0 extra lives.

[h2]Extra lives[/h2] are your limited checkpoints! Struggling with a certain section of level? Be on the lookout for extra lives throughout the level to increase your likelihood of success. If you die without any extra lives then you will have to restart the level.

I have strived to make sure each death occurring in RETOOLED feels fair and made sure you have the tools/options to avoid them.

RETOOLED is meant to be challenging and is carefully crafted to give you a power trip and a sense of accomplishment once mastered.

[h3]The wait for RETOOLED is almost over, on the 25th of september it will be in your hands![/h3]

notes.title: Deep dive #3 - The colosseums
notes.content:
Back again! For the third post in the deep dives series we are taking a look at the process of creating an arena you fight in.

There are quite a few steps creating an arena for RETOOLED and very deceivingly time consuming.

[b]Flow structure[/b]
First step is to think of a flow structure that is unlike a previously created arena and then draw it on paper. This process is very iterative and works like a check gate to whether the initial idea has some flow structure problems in certain areas of the arena and if the idea is actually worth continuing working on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42427689/a46288ca2ebe9b1b8305217f05086f3f9ccbc8a7.jpg[/img]
With comment underneath: “This step requires a bit of imagination, if the player is at position X, what possible paths exist? From experience, a good design is having at least 3 paths available at most times.”

[b]Blockout[/b]
Next step is creating the blockout of the arena in Unreal Engine. Testing the feeling of running around in the arena, trying the different paths, figuring out if the scale and distance of things feels right. Checking different sightlines to see if something needs adjusting.
The second pass of this blockout phase is to look at the current paths and try to add divergent paths to them. By having these divergent paths emphasizes the use of different movement abilities the arena is now starting to feel like a playground coming together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42427689/ec04108337262239791cef2f8252427a6bdb1109.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42427689/0c62340c6d7ec6004fe90a15d742404ad835220a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42427689/88f3f4739372c3582274038a6b89525c2b114041.jpg[/img]
[b]AI prep[/b]
All this work and we haven’t even added the AIs YET !?... well it still requires a bit of prep work to get them working on new arenas and…
.
.
.
.. It’s done!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42427689/063b499f38d1872bf3320b2d4257b7d64eed8a13.jpg[/img]
[b]Arena Masters[/b]
For RETOOLED I have designed something called an “Arena Master”. It is essentially an object that lets me define how I want the fight to start, progress and end. There are a few arena fight “types” we can construct with this object and even mix them together.
[list]
[*] [b]Wave [/b]
Pure wave based or alternatively we could spawn an initial wave and as you destroy some bots more gets spawn in until the wave is consumed.
[*] [b]Hydra[/b]
Starts with a smaller initial wave and as you destroy some specific (or any) bots the amount of active bots increases. 6 turns into 12, 18 etc.
[*] [b]Phases[/b]
Similar to wave type but instead of having waves with a clear ending they add on top of each other until a completion condition is met.
[b]Endless[/b]
[*] Each of the previous types can be modified to be endless that will only stop as a completion condition is met. Perhaps a certain character is destroyed or an environmental puzzle is solved etc.
[/list]
To retain the DNA of a specific arena fight I tell individual AIs what spawn position I would like them to favor depending on the player position. Thanks to this setup arena fights in RETOOLED very rarely have specific spawn positions for certain AIs so it becomes essential to think and react in the moment of a fight.

Stringing a few of these together in sequence or mixing them together, it can get complex quickly.

[b]Playtest, playtest and playtest…. Ohh did I mention playtest?[/b]
Now the playtesting and adjustments begins. It is only now can you get a holistic view of the initial arena idea you had.

[b]Environment pass[/b]
All that remains is prop creations, lightning, bug hunting, optimization etc.

That is it for this deep dive on RETOOLED but it is not all. Follow along as there is more to come and of course… Thank you for reading!

notes.title: Massive Demo Update
notes.content:
The update is now live, here are the highlights!

[b]New enemy: Wasp tank[/b]
The most complex and advanced enemy I've designed so far. Beware of this mobile hover tank.
[b]
Updated the new player experience [/b]
- The order and locations of the abilities you unlocked has changed, improving the progression.
- Made several level design changes to Awakening and Parabellum to improve flow and add complexity to some arenas.
- New and improved tutorials.

[b]The HUD[/b] has been cleaned up and changed to increase the readability.

[b]Graphical Improvements[/b]
- Every enemy has received texture reworks. Some even received new meshes and new animations.
- Every weapon have received updated meshes and textures. The railgun got updated animations and changes to it's SFX and VFXs.
- Jumppads, lights and several other objects have received new meshes and textures.
- New lightning pass on every level, improving readability and immersion.

[b]The Great Rebalancing[/b]
With all of the enemies now complete for the release I decided to do a complete rebalance of the combat values. Nothing has been left untouched. To summarize everyone is now more deadly, including you :).

Enjoy and take care,

/Oliver Lagerblad
Swarm Creations

notes.title: DEMO - Weapons Update
notes.content:
Update highlights:
[list]
[*]Weapons have more weight with a revamped recoil system.
[*]         New kickback animations for each weapon.
[*]         Updated impact VFXs
[*] Projectiles now leave impacts and scorch marks on the environment and enemies.
[*]     Built a camera shake system that can be changed to the players preference with 3 presets.
[*]     AI: Sentinel enemy now keeps further away from the player and makes more accurate shoots while having a more elevated position giving it a more unique identity among the roaster.
[*]     Boosted Jump: Made several changes to make it more accessible and consistent. Easier to land those awesome trick jumps within the arenas. Hold "jump" to boost yourself off the environment or the enemies.
[*]     Tutorials: Adjusted several tutorials to make them more streamlined.
[*]     Several bug fixes, including overlapping voicelines for the speedrunners out there.
[/list]
If you haven't tried the demo yet, now is time to bunnyhop your way into the action!
